title: High-Frequency Pricing at Scale for E-Commerce
title_zh: 面向大规模电商的高频定价
abstract_en: This paper presents the design, development, and implementation of a specialized forecast-then-optimize algorithmic pricing tool for sales campaigns in fashion e-commerce. Sales events present unique challenges for pricing including volatile demand patterns, rapid pricing decisions, and the need to balance short-term revenue with long-term profitability. We describe our approach combining daily-resolution demand forecasting using gradient-boosted trees with a multi-objective optimization framework that maximizes both long-term profit and net merchandise value for more than 5 million articles. Our solution addresses key limitations of existing weekly-granularity systems by implementing a forecast-then-optimize architecture that reduces pricing decision time from hours to minutes. We validate our approach through 23 A/B tests across 12 markets during 2023-2024 sales campaigns at Zalando, one of Europe's leading online fashion retailers. Experimental results demonstrate that the new pricing system achieves approximately 6% higher profit while maintaining equivalent performance on sales and revenue compared to the previous manual-algorithmic hybrid approach. Based on these results, the algorithm was successfully deployed to production and now handles the majority of algorithmic pricing decisions for sales campaigns at the company.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了一个面向时尚电商促销活动的专用“先预测、后优化”（forecast-then-optimize）算法定价工具的设计、开发与落地。促销场景中的定价面临需求波动大、决策频率高，以及需要在短期收入和长期盈利之间权衡等挑战。作者的方法结合了基于 gradient-boosted trees 的日粒度需求预测，以及同时最大化长期利润和净商品价值（net merchandise value）的多目标优化框架，可覆盖超过 500 万件商品。该方案克服了现有周粒度系统的局限，将定价决策时间从数小时缩短到数分钟。作者在 2023–2024 年 Zalando 促销活动期间，跨 12 个市场进行了 23 次 A/B 测试验证。实验显示，相比此前的人工-算法混合方案，新系统在销售额和收入表现基本持平的同时，实现了约 6% 的利润提升。基于这些结果，该算法已成功部署到生产环境，并承担 Zalando 促销活动中大部分算法定价决策。
key_points_zh: 提出面向时尚电商促销活动的大规模 forecast-then-optimize 定价系统，覆盖超过 500 万件商品。
使用 gradient-boosted trees 进行日粒度需求预测，相比传统周粒度系统更适合高频促销定价。
构建多目标优化框架，同时优化长期利润与 net merchandise value，平衡短期销售和长期盈利。
系统将定价决策时间从数小时降低到数分钟，显著提升大规模促销场景下的运营效率。
在 Zalando 2023–2024 年跨 12 个市场的 23 次 A/B 测试中，利润提升约 6%，且销售和收入表现保持相当。

llm_assessment.comment: A strong production e-commerce pricing system with clear business impact, though it is less central to search, recommendation, or agentic shopping workflows.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一套具有明确业务收益的生产级电商定价系统，但与搜索、推荐或智能体购物流程的核心关联较弱。
